LanguageData.LP_SoulBolt.label: soulfire bolt
LanguageData.LP_SoulBolt.description: Uses vanilla psyfocus and neural heat. The effect gets a diminishing bonus from psychic sensitivity; phylactery growth lowers the same number of points as a share of the psyfocus bar.
LanguageData.LP_MendConstruct.label: soul stitch
LanguageData.LP_MendConstruct.description: Repair your own wounded necromantic constructs. Heals 15 × the caster's current psychic sensitivity (100% = 1), growing linearly with no multiplier or heal cap; can repair several wounds in a row, never healing more than the existing injuries. Base psyfocus cost 10, not increased by psychic sensitivity; neural heat 8. Phylactery growth lowers the same number of points as a share of the psyfocus bar.
